revision_notes: FLAG FOR HUMAN REVIEW — not confirmed, not asserted. ICASA attributes a '14% less likely' mobile-internet gender gap specifically to South Africa, citing GSMA's 2024 report — but GSMA's own Mobile Gender Gap Report gives 14-15% as the LMIC-wide global average, while its separately-reported Sub-Saharan Africa regional average is 29% (2024, which would fall in the 'Moderate gap 20-29%' band). GSMA's underlying survey covers only a subset of 12 LMICs and it is unclear whether South Africa was included; ICASA's figure may conflate the global average with a national one. No independently-sourced South Africa-specific GSMA/ITU gender-gap figure could be confirmed this session — recommend human verification before relying on this score.
